sourceContext.originPage: Admiral magazine article (10 ways to make your car last longer)

contentPattern.structure: bordered pod: author avatar + author name (heading) + role (heading) + descriptive bio paragraph (with inline link) + 'Share with your friends...' heading + social share-icon row

suitableFor: end-of-article author identity pods (avatar + name + role + full bio paragraph)
boxed 'about the author' cards that also carry a share-icon row
single contributor pods that need a descriptive body paragraph, not just name + role
notSuitableFor: compact one-line byline strips with no bio paragraph (use cards-byline)
article teaser grids with image + title + description linking to detail pages (use cards-teaser)

usage.notes: NEW variant created for the Admiral magazine article author-bio pod (.story__expert.pod): Gareth Herincx avatar, name (H3), 'Motoring journalist' role (H3), a full bio paragraph with an inline 'Automotive Blog' link, plus a 'Share with your friends...' heading and Facebook/X/native-share icon links. Closest existing variant cards-team scored below 0.8 (it is explicitly NOT suitable for cards needing a body description). The .story__share sub-block is a DOM child of the pod and is carried inside this block. Share links are static; forms out of scope.
